Smooth is a skill.
DrivePerf turns every drive into a story of how smoothly you drove, and helps you get better at it. Every drive, decoded.
Get started
How recording works
DrivePerf uses your phone\'s location and motion sensors while you drive. Everything stays on your phone unless you choose to back it up.
Phone sensors can miss things: a tunnel, a weak GPS signal, or a phone that moved in its mount. When that happens DrivePerf says so instead of guessing.
It cannot tell whether you are the driver or a passenger, so you can mark a drive as a passenger trip.
Allow location while you use the app
DrivePerf needs your precise location to record the route and measure each drive. It is used only while a drive is recording.
Without location DrivePerf cannot record a drive. You can allow it later in Settings.
You chose approximate location. Recording needs precise location to measure a drive accurately.
Record automatically
To start recording on its own when you drive off, DrivePerf needs location access all the time, even when the app is closed. On the next screen choose \"Allow all the time\".
DrivePerf only uses background location to detect and record drives. It never sells or shares your location.
Automatic recording is off. You can still start every drive yourself with the Start button.
Tell driving from walking
Physical activity access lets your phone tell when you are in a vehicle, which helps start and end drives at the right time.
Without it DrivePerf will rely on location alone and may start or end drives less precisely.
Show when a drive is recording
A notification tells you a drive is being recorded and lets you stop it. Android also needs it to keep recording reliably in the background.
Without notifications you will not see when a drive is recording.
Keep recording reliable
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which can cut a drive short. If you see that happen, set DrivePerf to \"Unrestricted\" in the battery settings.
